_comment: On-policy self-distillation precondition measurements. Reports SCREENING YIELD (precondition 1) and the DISTILLATION TRAINING OUTCOME (precondition 2). Both are negative results at this scale; see paper Section 4.3.

precondition_1_trajectory_yield._definition: A rollout is 'usable' if it contains a \boxed{} final answer within gen_budget. 'correct' additionally requires the boxed answer to match the reference.

runs.note: Failures were coherent but never concluded: zero boxed-but-wrong answers, low repetition. A budget/termination failure, not a reasoning-quality failure.
Same model, same checkpoint. Sampling parameters alone move yield from 0% to 76%.
Independent replication of the yield collapse on a second model family, from an earlier pipeline iteration.

precondition_2_teacher_student_divergenc.variant: OPSD-1, privileged teacher (reference solution in teacher prompt), teacher 1 tok/step vs student 2 tok/step
precondition_2_teacher_student_divergenc.description: Distillation loss collapsed toward zero within the first few optimizer steps and stayed there. Per-position inspection showed the teacher's distribution barely differs from the student's when conditioned on a reference solution, so the clipped KL target carried almost no gradient.
precondition_2_teacher_student_divergenc.external_corroboration: Luo et al. 2026 (arXiv:2606.18195) report the same mechanism at 8B scale via their Overlap Top-K metric: reference-solution prefixing leaves teacher and student Top-K distributions nearly identical.
precondition_2_teacher_student_divergenc.scope: This is a negative result about the reference-prefix teacher construction at 4B scale, NOT about on-policy self-distillation in general.
precondition_2_teacher_student_divergenc.untested: OPSD-2 (self-future / lookahead teacher, notebooks/05) is the more promising construction and was not run to completion at full scale.

limitations.reason: Screening plus distillation is compute-heavy: at gen_budget=1536 a single training pass costs roughly 12x an inference pass per problem. See docs/COMPUTE.md.
